gloss: classical vocalist; classical singer; vocal artist

definitions.gloss: a professional singer in the classical or art-music tradition — typically an opera singer, lieder singer, or trained soloist, as distinguished from a popular or rock singer
definitions.explanation: Refers specifically to someone trained in the art of {声楽|せいがく} (classical vocal music) — opera, art song, oratorio, or church music. The word carries an image of formal concert halls, Western classical training, and sustained academic study, and would not be applied to a J-pop singer or street musician.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{声楽家|せいがくか}だ。
examples.english: She is a famous classical vocalist.

examples.japanese: {声楽家|せいがくか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I entered a music college aiming to become a classical vocalist.

examples.japanese: ⟦イタリア→イタリア：19423_itaria⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}んだ→積む：02294_tsumu⟧{声楽家|せいがくか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A classical vocalist who trained in Italy will be performing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧、⟦{現役|げんえき}→現役：21782_geneki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{声楽家|せいがくか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: While he has taught at the university for many years, he is also active as a working classical vocalist.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{声楽|せいがく}→声楽：12157_seigaku⟧ ("vocal music," specifically in the classical tradition) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ ("specialist, -ist"). Denotes a trained singer of Western classical repertoire — not a pop or folk singer.

USAGE:
- Often modified by voice type in more detailed descriptions: ソプラノ⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧ / バリトン⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧ are common alternatives when naming a specific voice part.
- Typical verbs: ⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧ ("to aspire to become"), ⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧ ("to be active as"), ⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ("to debut").
- Career context: {声楽家|せいがくか} almost always implies formal training through a conservatory or music university.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{声楽家|せいがくか}: a famous classical vocalist
- {声楽家|せいがくか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aspire to become a classical vocalist
- ⟦{現役|げんえき}→現役：21782_geneki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{声楽家|せいがくか}: an active/working classical vocalist
- {声楽家|せいがくか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to be active as a classical vocalist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧: singer — the most general word; includes pop, rock, enka, and classical.
- ⟦オペラ→オペラ：28763_opera⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧: opera singer — a specific kind of classical vocalist.
- ⟦{音楽家|おんがくか}→音楽家：27511_ongakuka⟧: musician — broader term covering performers and composers.
- {作曲家|さっきょくか}: composer — parallel formation (⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ = specialist).
